name: Todos
description: A to-do list that looks and feels like a late-80s adventure game, with EGA colors, beveled buttons and a text-parser prompt. It works with your Todoist tasks using the same commands as Todoist's td command-line tool, and clicking a button types the command out for you so you learn them as you go.
stack: Vanilla JS, Vite, Todoist API, Cloudflare

name: Status Rodeo
description: Short statuses from a small herd of friends. It started as a way to post a status and show the latest one on this site, and grew into a tiny social network with profiles, link previews, hat tips and RSS feeds.
stack: Vanilla JS, Vite, Supabase, Cloudflare Pages
